title: 琥珀の夜、霧の村を辿る
author: 花房 綾

prediction.question: 櫂が最後に残した言葉の意味と、二人の次の行動は？
options: 櫂が村の地図を紬に託す
店に不穏な来客が現れる
二人が夜の街へ走り出す

en.title: Amber Nights, Tracing the Village of Mist
en.premise: Tsumugi, a college student working at a late-night cafe, encounters Kai, a young man who appeared like a migratory bird out of season. Kai is chasing the nostalgic and bittersweet memories of a "lost village" that has supposedly been erased from all maps. Amidst the aroma of coffee and the silence of the night, their loneliness begins to melt together, accompanied by a faint scent of perfume.

zh.title: 琥珀之夜，追寻雾之村
zh.premise: 在深夜咖啡店工作的大学生紬，遇见了如不合时节的候鸟般出现的青年——櫂。櫂所追寻的，是那座据传已从地图上抹去的“消失之村”中，那份既怀旧又伤感的记忆。在咖啡的香气与深夜的静谧中，两人的孤独伴随着淡淡的香水味，悄然交融。
